cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's reassure the stallholders that the fair is still on. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You panicked about the forecast and told them to cancel their vans.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I have the right contact list. I'll say the arrangements are unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their arrangements changed because of you. Two vans are cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find replacements. Could your update call it a transport hiccup? They need something calm to read.

mechanism: A leads fair recovery and adjusts transport arrangements to keep B helping while concealing how A panic caused the cancellations.
confusable: Unlike merely managing a logistical failure, A caused it through fear and now seeks a calming euphemism; dependence on B shapes the remedy.
comparison: Public event transport differs from a club accusation that damaged one treasurer reputation.
seedUse: D109-a forecast panic and two cancelled vans; S02-a adapts a declared plan when the partner supplies incompatible facts.
